title: 0.1 + 0.2 is exact here
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ v: 0.1 + 0.2, eq: (0.1 + 0.2) == 0.3, t: typeOf(0.1 + 0.2) }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ v: 0.1 + 0.2, eq: (0.1 + 0.2) == 0.3, t: typeOf(0.1 + 0.2) }

explanation.approach: No floating-point residue, and the type is still a plain Number. The habit of guarding against `0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3` comes from other languages and does not apply here.
